question: The Olympic rings were publicly presented for the first time in:
solution:
The correct answer is __**1913.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Olympic rings** were publicly presented for the first time in **1913**.
 
• In the centre of a white background, five rings interlaced: **blue, yellow, black, green and red.**
 
• Blue, yellow, black, green, and red are the order of the color of the Olympic logo rings.
 
• It represents five continents: Asia, Africa, America, Australia, and Europe.
 
• The Olympic Charter once ascribed a ring color to each continent: blue for Europe, yellow for Asia, black for Africa, green for Oceania (or Australia), and red for America.
